So a little sister to right away. I get back to college and she sent me that Dwyane Wade sidekick. And if anybody knows, that was like the coolest thing. I used to send in class and flip it up.

quotes.speaker: Dwyane Wade
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwyane Wade on the importance of belief and dreaming
quotes.excerpt: Before the world ever saw Dwyane Wade, Robbins saw me first.
quotes.quote: Before the world ever saw Dwyane Wade, Robbins saw me first. Robbins saw me, not just the basketball player, not the champion, not the Hall of Famer, just that kid. A kid who family was looking for what every family is looking for, a chance. A place where tomorrow felt like it could be better than today. I never forget my first night here. We moved in after dark one night and I just listened, and it was quiet. And that was different for us. And it wasn't just quiet, it was peace. It was possibility. It gave my dreams room to breathe. The first thing Robbins gave me was belief. It gave me permission to believe that my life could be bigger than what I could see. And when you believe, you start to dream differently.
